description: The user's posts that still have to be submitted to their campaign on Content Rewards: each with the minutes left in its 30-minute window, the campaign's submit link and the post link, soonest first. Posts whose window has closed are listed as missed (Content Rewards does not take a late link), and posts already marked submitted are counted. Covers clips posted through post_clip and clips added with track_my_clip.
name: to_submit
title: Posts still inside their 30-minute submit window
